props.name: className
props.description: CSS class applied to the element, or a function that returns a class based on the component's state. Extra classes, merged after the area's own. Give the area a height, such as `h-72`, or a max height, such as `max-h-72`. Under a max height, short content keeps the area at its content height, and longer content scrolls once it reaches the cap.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Which single scrollbar `Root` renders, and so which axis the content scrolls on. A vertical area holds its content to the viewport's width, so `truncate` text ellipsizes at the edge. A horizontal area lets its content grow to its widest line and scroll. For two-axis scrolling, compose Base UI's `ScrollArea` root, content and corner with a `ScrollArea.Viewport` and two `ScrollArea.Bar`s, one per orientation.

props.name: type
props.description: When the scrollbar shows. `hover` shows it on hover or scroll, `always` keeps it mounted and visible, and `auto` mounts it only while the content overflows.

props.name: children
props.description: Base UI's `ScrollArea.Content` around the area's content. Render the viewport as a direct child of Base UI's `ScrollArea.Root`, which positions itself, so the focus outline follows the root's edge and corners. A positioned element between the two takes the outline on its own box instead. A focused viewport paints over its earlier siblings, so render the `ScrollArea.Bar`s and Base UI's `ScrollArea.Corner` after it. A visible scrollbar thumb then covers the outline where the thumb sits.

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class applied to the element, or a function that returns a class based on the component's state. Extra classes, merged after the viewport's own. Size the viewport to the root. Under a root with a definite height, use `size-full`. Under a root capped by `max-height`, `size-full` leaves the viewport at its content's height, so the root clips the content and Tab skips the viewport. Make that root a flex column and give the viewport `min-h-0 flex-1`, as `ScrollArea.Root` does.
